item.title: Supreme Court unanimously rebukes lower court's handling of Whole Foods baby food case
item.description: Supreme Court unanimously upholds ruling in Whole Foods baby food case, sending the lawsuit back to Texas state court after federal dispute.

item.title: Ford recalls more than 412,000 vehicles over suspension issue
item.description: Ford Motor Co. is recalling more than 412,000 vehicles in the U.S. due to the potential for steering control loss in model year 2017 to 2019 Explorer SUVs.

item.title: Public Storage relocates headquarters from California to Texas
item.description: Public Storage will relocate its headquarters to Texas alongside a CEO change and a broader plan aimed at boosting margins, earnings and shareholder returns.

item.title: Novo Nordisk to slash list prices of Ozempic, Wegovy by up to 50%
item.description: Novo Nordisk announced up to 50% price cuts for Ozempic and Wegovy diabetes and weight-loss drugs starting January 2027, lowering costs to $675 per dose.

item.title: Lamborghini scraps first EV launch, calls development 'expensive hobby'
item.description: Lamborghini canceled plans for an upcoming electric vehicle launch due to a lack of consumer demand and will replace it with a plug-in hybrid instead, CEO Stephan Winkelmann said.

item.title: Spirit Airlines reaches deal to exit bankruptcy proceedings by early summer
item.description: Spirit Airlines announced an agreement with lenders to emerge from bankruptcy this year as a leaner airline focused on high-demand routes and premium seating options.

item.title: Consumer confidence rebounds in February as Americans grow less pessimistic about jobs
item.description: February consumer confidence improved but stayed below 2024 peaks as households continue weighing job market prospects against persistent cost worries.

item.title: Trump eyes bank citizenship checks amid immigration crackdown: reports
item.description: Banks are worried about operational burdens as the Trump administration discusses requiring new documentation like passports from customers to verify citizenship status for accounts.

item.title: Dog treats recalled over fears of salmonella contamination, FDA says
item.description: The FDA announced a recall of Elite Treats Chicken Chips for Dogs due to potential salmonella contamination. No illnesses have been reported yet.

item.title: Possible bullet holes mysteriously appear on American Airlines plane after flight from Colombia
item.description: American Airlines jet discovered with possible bullet holes after Miami landing from Colombia. Aircraft grounded for investigation following inspection.
